title: NavWM: A Unified Navigation World Model for Foresight-Driven Planning
title_zh: NavWM：用于前瞻驱动规划的统一导航世界模型
abstract_en: Conventional visual navigation policies often struggle with myopic decision-making and mode collapse in complex environments. While world models offer a promising alternative, existing paradigms typically isolate perception, generation, and control, failing to capture their shared spatio-temporal dynamics. In this paper, we propose NavWM, a unified navigation world model that seamlessly integrates latent world reasoning, multimodal action prediction, and controllable visual generation. At its core, NavWM leverages latent world tokens to distill geometric and semantic priors, endowing the agent with robust structural understanding. To overcome the limitations of deterministic policies, we introduce an anchor-based multimodal trajectory forecasting framework that generates a diverse action space. This inherent diversity explicitly empowers the generative world model to act as a robust closed-loop planner, utilizing visual foresight to evaluate and select the optimal path. Extensive experiments across diverse robotics datasets demonstrate that NavWM significantly advances the state-of-the-art, delivering remarkable improvements in both high-fidelity future state generation and zero-shot navigation success.
abstract_zh: 传统视觉导航策略在复杂环境中常受限于短视决策和模式坍缩。NavWM 提出一种统一的导航世界模型，将潜在世界推理、多模态动作预测与可控视觉生成整合到同一框架中。其核心是利用 latent world tokens 提炼几何与语义先验，使智能体具备更强的结构理解能力。为突破确定性策略的局限，NavWM 引入基于 anchor 的多模态轨迹预测框架，生成多样化动作空间，并让生成式世界模型通过视觉前瞻评估候选路径，从而进行稳健的闭环规划。大量机器人数据集实验表明，NavWM 在高保真未来状态生成与 zero-shot 导航成功率上均显著优于现有方法。
key_points_zh: 提出 NavWM，将感知、生成与控制统一建模，捕捉视觉导航中的共享时空动态。
通过 latent world tokens 蒸馏几何与语义先验，增强智能体对环境结构的理解。
采用 anchor-based 多模态轨迹预测，缓解确定性策略的模式坍缩问题，提供多样候选动作。
生成式世界模型可基于视觉前瞻对未来状态进行预测与评估，实现闭环路径选择。
在多个机器人数据集上取得 SOTA，尤其提升高保真未来生成和 zero-shot 导航成功率。

llm_assessment.comment: NavWM offers a useful unified world-model planning framework that combines foresight, action prediction, and generation.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: NavWM 提供了一个将预见、动作预测与生成结合的统一世界模型规划框架。
